summary: This plugin for DeepSeek Harness mounts a local Markdown folder as long-term memory, injects an index into prompts, and lets the model read referenced memory files on demand.

classificationSuggestion.reason: The plugin is primarily a memory/context plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it mounts a local Markdown folder as long-term memory, indexes entries from a file like MEMORY.md, and injects that context into prompts so the model can read specific memory files on demand. Evidence from the README and package description consistently centers on filesystem-based memory recall and session-based refresh behavior, with current limitations on write support and recursive indexing acknowledged.
